one_line: A seven-cylinder air-cooled radial: finned cast-iron cylinders at 51.4286 deg spacing, each seated in a stepped counterbore socket in the revolved aluminium crankcase (crank axis Z), two-blade walnut propeller with yellow tips and brass spinner at the front, steel exhaust collector ring at the rear; every instance fixed, no mates, every joint a fitted clearance.
poses: hero: iso view from the front-right (eye 215,-265,190 mm, target 0,0,12), propeller horizontal, one cylinder straight up - images/hero.png
detail: closer front view (eye 130,-160,110 mm, target 0,30,30) showing spinner, pitched blades with yellow tips, finned barrels and pushrod tubes - images/detail.png
specs: 7 cylinders in the XY plane at 360/7 = 51.4286 deg spacing, one pointing straight up (+Y); barrel r 11.5 mm, y 38..92 from the engine centre, base flange ring r 13 at radial 50..59 seated in the case socket, 4 cooling fins r 14.5 x 2.2 mm, head block 26 x 18 x 24 mm with rocker box, 2 pushrod tubes r 1.6 mm, exhaust stub

Crankcase revolved about Z: rear flange r 58 mm at z -22 (step at z -20.9), main case r 58 mm, front cover at z +18; slim rear neck (r 37-44) so the collector ring runs clear of the case; per-cylinder stepped sockets r 15.5 / r 11.9, front shaft bore r 7.3, counterweight cavity r 19.5
Exhaust collector ring: torus, tube r 4.2 mm on a r 46 mm circle at z -16, dark steel

Propeller: hub r 13 mm (z 30..42) bored r 7.3 over the shaft, two blades 64 x 13 x 4 mm pitched 22 deg, yellow tip blocks as separate solids; overall prop diameter 146 mm; brass spinner cone r 13 at z 42.3 to a point at z 62.3
Overall: 240 mm across opposite rocker boxes, 84.3 mm deep (z -22..+62.3), crankcase diameter 116 mm
Mass 2.87 kg (ryucad mass, volume 543508 mm^3) at modelled densities: aluminium 2700, cast iron 7200, steel 7850, brass 8500, walnut 640 kg/m^3
